content:
Following Amazon's updated early fall Prime Day sale and the ongoing $50 off deal on AirPods Pro 3, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance discount has also returned, nearly $200 off the original price. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also features $150 off the Apple 13-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air, the return of launch discounts on Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini, and nearly 20% off the Apple Magic Keyboard. These deals also include the Beats braided USB-C cable for under $8, along with a series of fresh exclusive discounts on iPhone 18 Pro cases. Check out everything below.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (originally $249)

Back in stock: Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop strap at clearance pricing of nearly $200 off, the lowest ever

With the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 officially announced, we are still tracking multiple early launch deals on Amazon. You can find them below, but Amazon's clearance deals cover two of the best-looking Apple Watch Ultra configurations, back in stock at nearly $200 off.

Amazon is currently offering the Black Titanium and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models with the Milanese Loop strap priced as low as $699.97 with shipping.

That's $199 off compared to the original price of $899 and the equivalent Ultra 4 model.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)

We saw these two deals yesterday, but they quickly began going in and out of stock, and now they appear to be available again. The all-time low clearance prices on Apple Watch that appear right after new models launch are often the best choice for consumers who want an Apple wearable but don't need the latest model, and the Ultra 3 still has more than enough performance and looks nearly identical to the new one.

Meanwhile, the Series 12 and Ultra 4 now have the following launch discounts:

Apple Watch Series 12

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 42mm: $390 (originally $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $440 (originally $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $540 (originally $549)

Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4 GPS + Cellular 49mm: $780 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4, 49mm, GPS + Cellular: $780 (originally $799)

Apple 13-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air drops $150 at Amazon, with up to $300 off refurbished models

While we are still tracking major discounts of up to $300 off on 15-inch models through the Apple official refurbished store, Amazon is now offering multiple 13-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air configurations for $150 off the original price.

The Apple official refurbished store has been a great place to score deals on the M5 MacBook Air, especially over the past three months or so. However, inventory is quite limited, with only 15-inch models on sale right now.

Meanwhile, Amazon is now offering a solid $150 discount on brand new 14-inch models. This includes the mid-range 1TB configuration and the upgraded version with 24GB RAM:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (originally $1,799)

As for the Apple refurbished deals, the available colors have become increasingly limited since our last feature, but you can still grab some configurations with up to $300 off right now:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new)
  • Starlight, Sky Blue

Launch discounts return on Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini

In addition to the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal and early launch discounts on the Apple Watch Series 12, Amazon has also brought back the launch discount on Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini.

Amazon is once again offering the new M6 Mac mini with 24GB RAM and 512GB storage at $1,269.99 with shipping.

Compared to the $1,299 MSRP, the discount is admittedly not huge, but this brand new machine has dropped back to the lowest price we've tracked, making it a nice opportunity to save for those looking to get in early. The early bird discount on the new M6 Mac mini has been somewhat volatile since launch, bouncing between MSRP and the discounted price, but as of writing, we have two configurations available to grab.

The deal on the 24GB model comes alongside a deal on the mid-range 16GB model—we'll continue to keep an eye on the entry-level model and the M5 Pro:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)

The most affordable USB-C Apple Magic Keyboard is nearly 20% off today only

Expand your new Mac setup with Hyper's latest Thunderbolt 5 Dock, $80 off (Amazon low)

One of Hyper's newest accessories for MacBook and Mac mini/Studio has dropped back to its lowest price on record at Amazon—$80 off the HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD Enclosure.

The brand's official Amazon store is once again offering its latest HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD Enclosure at $319.99 with shipping.

Originally priced at $400, this deal matches the $80 off lowest price we've tracked at Amazon since its release earlier this year.

Launch deal on the new Beats 360 ANC headphones: limited modular Cushion Kit bundle for $10

As we mentioned yesterday in our larger Beats roundup, the Apple-owned brand has now officially launched the all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones with modular ear cups and headband cushions. In addition to being on sale now, we also have a Beats 360 launch deal with the Beats 360 Cushion Kit available at a limited-time discounted price—as low as $9.99.

The all-new Beats 360 headphones feature a modular design that allows users to swap out the ear cups and headband cushions. The headphones themselves ship with a matching set of cushions, of course, but there are now seven different colorways of the Beats 360 Cushion Kit available at a discount, so you can mix and match styles or swap in a fresh set after a workout.

  • Beats 360 over-ear headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (originally $50)

Early fall Prime Day Ring deals from $40: latest 4K model hits new low with $100 off, more options

Early fall Amazon Prime Day deals cover the Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro and battery wireless model, both dropped to all-time lows at Amazon with 40% off. Keep reading for more detailed coverage and other early Prime Big Deal Days deals, with models starting from $40 with shipping.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (originally $250)

What you're seeing now are Ring's two newest 4K video smart doorbells, both originally priced at $250. With $100 off, you're saving 40%, marking an all-time low at Amazon—before today's early fall Prime deals, these models had never dropped below $180.

While Amazon did indeed kick off early fall Prime Day deals earlier than the October 6 start date this year, they clearly continue to add new items to the early bird deals, and some are genuinely quite attractive.

These two models are largely identical in features, with the only difference being the wired or fully wireless battery-powered option—the wireless model comes with a Quick Release Ultra Battery Pack for convenient charging and a noticeably simpler installation (no wiring required), while the wired model offers "endless power, uninterrupted protection." Beyond that, both feature 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and Retinal 4K video with a wide-angle lens.
